cells: resolveCenter: function resolveCenter(center?: Vec3 | [number, number] | [number, number, number]): { x: number; y: number; z: number }

Implementation: `if (!center) return { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }; if (Array.isArray(center)) { return { x: center[0] ?? 0, y: center[1] ?? 0, z: center[2] ?? 0 }; } return { x: center.x, y: center.y, z: center.z };`.
